messages.author: 9676a88bcd2419b9
messages.subject: Re: row coloring and DT::datatable
parts:
The answer to this question is here -- http://stackoverflow.com/questions/28553771/stripes-for-dtdatatable/28560177

 rowCallback=JS(
  'function(row,data) {
     if($(row)["0"]["_DT_RowIndex"] % 6 <3) 
            $(row).css("background","orange")
 }')

Thanks.
